name: App Listing Screenshots
original_description: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots right in ChatGPT—without local rendering setup. Turn one or more captures into a single image or a coordinated series with headlines, backgrounds, and device frames. Choose supported store sizes or custom dimensions, preview the result, and download full-resolution PNGs in one ZIP. Try the workflow with a sample if you do not have captures ready. This creates image files; it does not publish to store accounts. Source images, projects and new series exports remain stored until you request deletion. New series download links have no automatic expiry.

limitations_ja: ストアへの公開は行わない。元画像や出力は削除を依頼するまで保存され、新しいシリーズのリンクは自動失効しないと説明。
